verdict.rationale: Warp is an HR/payroll platform, so off-cycle payroll is an applicable axis. The evidence mentions payroll only in general terms, with no documentation of running off-cycle payrolls for bonuses, corrections, or terminations outside the regular schedule. Scheduled jobs and benefit deductions are adjacent features and do not count as off-cycle payroll runs.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run an off-cycle payroll for bonuses, corrections, or terminations outside the regular schedule
